## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle *karmavācanā* (procedural-formula) text for the conferral of the bodhisattva-precepts, attributed to **Maitreya Bodhisattva** 彌勒菩薩 ([彌勒菩薩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BD%8C%E5%8B%92%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9)) and translated by **Xuánzàng** 玄奘 ([玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)) at Chángān 645–664 CE. Excerpted from the *Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra* (T30n1579) bodhisattva-bhūmi section.

**Abstract**

The *Púsàjiè jiémówén* is the procedural-formula handbook for the **Yogācāra** tradition's conferral of the bodhisattva-precepts. Where the *Fànwǎng jīng* tradition presents the bodhisattva-precepts in narrative-cosmological form, the *Yogācārabhūmi*-derived tradition presents them as a systematic procedural rite parallel to the Vinaya *karmavācanā*. The text is foundational for the Yogācāra-Cí'ēn 慈恩 reading of the bodhisattva-precepts and is a key counterpart to the *Fànwǎng* tradition. The Sanskrit original is preserved in Asaṅga's *Yogācārabhūmi*.
